# CANDIDATE: YIELD_CURVE_VWAP_RECLAIM

**Filed:** 2026-07-09  
**Filer:** chef-nemotron (free-tier autonomous R&D)  
**Type:** new_trigger  
**Status:** DRAFT (NEEDS-RATIFICATION per Rule 9)

## Hypothesis

A steepening US Treasury yield curve (10yr‑2yr increasing) signals rising risk‑on sentiment, increasing the probability that a short‑term pullback will find support at VWAP and resume the intraday trend. Conversely, a flattening curve signals risk‑off, raising the odds of a failed VWAP reclamation and continuation of the pullback. This macro primitive provides a regime filter absent from existing strategies, improving the edge of VWAP reclamation setups by aligning them with broader market bias.

## Mechanism

**Entry (long):**  
- Daily change in (10yr yield – 2yr yield) > 0 (steepening)  
- Price touches VWAP (within $0.02) with bullish ribbon (EMA8 > EMA21 > EMA55)  
- RSI(14) < 40  
- Enter long at the close of the bar that makes the VWAP touch  
**Entry (short):**  
- Daily change in (10yr yield – 2yr yield) < 0 (flattening)  
- Price touches VWAP with bearish ribbon (EMA8 < EMA21 < EMA55)  
- RSI(14) > 60  
- Enter short at the close of the bar that makes the VWAP touch  

**Exit:**  
- Initial stop: most recent swing low (long) or swing high (short) identified by 3‑bar pivot  
- TP1: 1× risk (distance from entry to initial stop)  
- Runner: chandelier exit trailed at 2.5× ATR(22)  
- Time filter: only active 10:00–12:00 EST, VIX < 20  
- Flat curve filter: skip if |daily yield curve change| ≤ 0.01%  
- News filter: avoid 15 min before/after high‑impact releases (FOMC, CPI, NFP, PPI, ISM)
